digest.component_or_area: file impact event model and CLI
propositions: Empty file_impact is ambiguous between author-forgot and no-repo-files; the feature adds an explicit third state (undeclared, paths, none) to disambiguate

FILE_IMPACT event payload gains optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys; reducer state gains corresponding keys with derivation logic to enforce mutual exclusivity via last-writer-wins
CLI set-file-impact command moves to _ARGV_REGISTRY to support both legacy JSON-array form and new --none flag form with reason validation (minimum 10 non-whitespace characters)
Library function get_file_impact_scope returns dict with kind, reason, and paths; MCP tool declare_no_file_impact performs same write operation with identical reason validation
Existing get-file-impact API and next_batch behavior remain unchanged; rebar show exposes new state keys for declared-none tickets
